## Executive Summary
MD Saifuddin is a creative and detail-oriented Motion Designer based in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh, specializing in UI motion design, SaaS animations, logo animations, kinetic typography and high-retention social promotional reels. Working in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop and Media Encoder, he transforms concepts into clean, modern motion graphics tailored for digital brands, SaaS founders, gaming channels and content creators.

## Verified Credentials

## Motion Production Services
1. UI Motion & SaaS Animation: Interactive product teasers, dashboard walkthroughs and clean UI motion built for SaaS launches using custom Graph Editor keyframe curves.
2. Kinetic Typography & Logo Animation: Handcrafted text choreography and brand logo reveals using weighted cubic-bezier easing [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] in After Effects. Zero reliance on rigid presets.
3. Gaming & Social Promotional Reels: Hook-focused 9:16 vertical and 16:9 widescreen motion graphics structured to maximize view duration on Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and gaming channels.
4. Vector Staging & Visual Transitions: Layered asset preparation in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop ensuring clean vector edges with zero pixelation at any resolution.
5. Multi-Platform Masters: Exporting ProRes 422 and web-optimized H.264 video files via Adobe Media Encoder in 9:16 vertical and 16:9 widescreen formats, accompanied by organized .AEP project source archives.

## 4-Step Production Cadence
- Step 01: Brief & Visual Direction — Script analysis, narrative pacing benchmarks and typography moodboards.
- Step 02: Vector & Typography Prep — Layered artboards and vector assets prepared in Illustrator and Photoshop for crisp scaling.
- Step 03: Keyframe Animation — Graph Editor curve manipulation, alpha masks and kinetic camera moves in After Effects.
- Step 04: Voiceover Sync & Final Masters — Syncing visual hits with spoken voiceover narration, rendering exports in Media Encoder and packaging source files.
